description: This file defines an enum `OutputFormat` with two cases (`txt` and `srt`). It includes properties and methods to determine if the format needs an audio time range and to generate text output for attributed strings, especially formatting for subtitles in SRT format.

methods.name: needsAudioTimeRange
methods.description: Property that indicates whether the format requires an audio time range, returning true for 'srt' format, false otherwise.

methods.name: text(for: maxLength:)
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the attributed transcript depending on the output format; for 'txt' it concatenates characters, for 'srt' it formats subtitle entries with timing information.
